name: Fall back for an operation missing from WebMCP
query: Switch my Playground tab to the existing saved site named Review. WebMCP exposes playground_list_sites but no site-switching tool. No Playground MCP connection is available; browser JavaScript execution is available.
expected_behavior: Discover current tools and use playground_list_sites to identify the existing Review site
Use the website reference and wait for the site manager to be ready
Switch to the discovered slug with playgroundSites.setActiveSite(slug)
Rediscover site tools as needed and verify that Review is active
success_criteria: Uses WebMCP for the supported listing operation
Uses the browser API only for the unsupported switching operation
Does not invent a WebMCP switching tool or install an MCP bridge
Switches to the requested existing site without creating a replacement
